tier1.text: Each spinalis thoracis supports and extends the spine, bending the spine back or bringing it upright. Each spinalis thoracis is a spinalis muscle of the thoracic region, the upper back. The spinalis muscles are part of the erector spinae, the large muscle mass of the back. Each spinalis thoracis runs between spinous processes, the bumps you can feel down the middle of the back.

quotes.quote: Origin: spinous processes of two upper lumbar and two lower thoracic; insertion: spines of upper thoracic vertebrae

The single spinous process (vertebral spine) projects posteriorly at the midline of the back. The vertebral spines can easily be felt as a series of bumps just under the skin down the middle of the back.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
